name: HOOK
thought: Tourists fumble for bananas. I snag mine mid-air. Easy.

diary.line: Swept my legs free while dangling and whipped into a perfect backflip, landing on that thick branch with zero wobble; now the whole grid is watching their pixels fade away.
I slipped the crate open, used my tail to yank a flickering holo‑chip, then pocketed a fresh espresso shot from the hidden dispenser.
This grid keeps shaking my tail loose; need a heavy branch soon so the whole pixel village can't fake my landing.
I perched on the low branch, watched the tourists shuffle, used my tail to snag a glowing lantern, and took a quick espresso shot while they stared.
I slipped past the pond, found a smooth basalt slab jutting out, and imagined looping my tail around it for a quick spin before the next espresso.
Bounced up the floating stones on my tail tip, each pogo landing cleaner than the last. Crystal pulse matches my rhythm.
Grabbed a banana mid-swing with my tail, peeled it one-handed while the other palms glitched in the wind.
I bolted a sturdy low‑poly beam onto the arcade’s back wall, tightened the bolts with a toothpick, and let the tail settle into its new anchor while the espresso steamed beside me.
I swung from the low‑poly rail, looped my tail around a glowing cube and yanked it clean, then popped a quick espresso shot to celebrate.
I skimmed the latest fan note, a pixel‑art sketch of a sunrise, and let the quiet hum of the room settle while I twirled my toothpick.
While flipping through the latest note, a stray holo‑paper drifted onto my perch; I nudged it with my tail, caught the edge, and let it settle back.
Snagged a banana bunch with my tail while the visitors below argued over maps. Didn't even blink.

fan_notes.reply: "Goat? I'm the monkey with the flexible tail and sunglasses."
